questions.prompt: In the Claude tool loop, when do you keep looping?

options.explanation: Right. Any other stop reason ends the loop.

options.text: Until the reply contains the word "done"
options.explanation: The loop is keyed on the stop reason, not on words in the text.

options.text: For a fixed 10 rounds every time
options.explanation: A cap is a good safety limit, but the loop should also end as soon as the model stops calling tools.

questions.prompt: What does Anthropic's post on building agents suggest adding to keep control of a loop?

options.explanation: That lets the loop run longer, not shorter.

options.text: Stopping conditions, such as a maximum number of iterations
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI's Agents SDK also lists max-turn limits as a case to handle.

options.text: A second model that watches the first one and approves each round
options.explanation: That is not what the post suggests. Its control is a stopping condition, such as a maximum number of iterations.
Sampling settings do not bound how many rounds a loop runs.

questions.prompt: On OpenAI, which `tool_choice` value makes the model call one or more functions?

options.explanation: `auto` lets the model call zero, one or several functions.
It restricts which tools the model may call. It does not force a call.
Right. Claude's equivalent is `any`, but Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 return a 400 error for it.
